title: Pinch your nose and try to hum
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO hook (hand pinching the nose in frame one), hum waveform flatlines at 7-10 s, a visible change every <= 2.5 s after it (H12), loop ending on the instruction

beats: Close your lips, pinch your nose, and hum.
Keep humming, as long as you can.
It stops. Air fills your mouth, and the hum is gone.
When you hum, the air leaves through your nose.
Pinch your nose shut, and the air piles up above your vocal folds.
The pressure there climbs until it almost matches your lungs.
With no push across them, the folds stop vibrating.
Pinch your nose, and try again.
